title: Oikonomou2016 – SSVEP MAMEM 3 dataset
description: This dataset comprises 14-channel EEG recordings from 11 healthy subjects performing a steady-state visually evoked potential (SSVEP) brain-computer interface task. Subjects attended to flickering visual stimuli presented at five different frequencies (6.66, 7.50, 8.57, 10.00, and 12.00 Hz) while EEG signals were recorded at 128 Hz using an EGI 300 Geodesic EEG System. The dataset includes preprocessed signals with bandpass filtering, artifact removal, and common average referencing, along with comprehensive documentation of signal processing pipelines and comparative evaluation of state-of-the-art BCI algorithms.
methods_description: EEG signals were acquired using an EGI 300 Geodesic EEG System (GES 300) with 14 scalp electrodes arranged in a 10-20 montage at 128 Hz sampling rate. Preprocessing included bandpass filtering (5-48 Hz), 50 Hz notch filtering, artifact removal using AMUSE and ICA, and common average referencing. Subjects performed SSVEP tasks with 5-second stimulus presentation periods separated by 5-second rest intervals. Each subject completed one adaptation period followed by five experimental sessions. Comparative evaluation of state-of-the-art algorithms was performed using leave-one-subject-out cross-validation, examining filtering methods (IIR, FIR), artifact removal techniques (AMUSE, ICA), feature extraction methods (Periodogram, Welch, Goertzel, Yule-AR, STFT, DWT), feature selection approaches (Shannon entropy, PCA, ICA), and multiple classifiers (LDA, SVM, kNN, Naive Bayes, Random Forest, CCA, ELM, Decision Trees).
